originality.rationale: Three-form fused search found no prior stating the non-coprime single-wall with semistable chambers and generalized proportional JS corrections. Nearest prior Jardim-Lo-Maciocia-Martinez arXiv:2503.20008 Main Theorem 1/Theorem 6.1 explicitly requires v0,v1 relatively prime; full-text coprime search and Sections 4-6 show semistable results only as one-way implications and no generalized formula. Joyce-Song book and Toda chapters give general U-formula machinery for strictly semistables but not this wall location or chamber identification. Prior authors deliberately separated stable/semistable, so headline is not mechanically implied or renamed; as a statement it is new. Originality PASS.
